subtitle.viltrumitecore.venom.whisper_0: Don't fight it. We are warm together.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.venom.whisper_3: You are weak. We are not.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.venom.whisper_4: Give us your arms. Give us your legs.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.venom.boss_frenz: You hurt us… Now we are HUNGRY!
subtitle.viltrumitecore.venom.boss_starv: We will not die! We will eat you whole!
subtitle.viltrumitecore.venom.boss_adapt: Hiding behind arrows? We have a shell.
The roof will not save you.
ability.viltrumitecore.venom_symbiosis.d: The symbiote covers the body in 2.3 s: arms and legs, torso and head, height and muscle, the mouth, eyes and emblem, then the stance. In form: 40 health, armor, +18% speed, ~11-block jump, wall and facade running, regeneration. LMB: claws (three-hit combo); RMB: grab with tendrils (then LMB throws, RMB slams). Press again and the symbiote recedes. Cooldown 2 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.venom_tendril.des: A 28-block tendril. Into a wall: zip to it; into an enemy: yank and hold it (to a boss, a giant or with Shift: zip to it); into a Spider's web: wrap the line and climb it to the anchor. Cooldown 1.3 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.venom_tentacle_la: A three-hit tentacle combo: a circular sweep (4.6 blocks, 8 damage), a forward impale (7.5 blocks, 12 damage) and an overhead slam (radius 5, 13 damage). Mixes with the claws and cuts webs. Cooldown 3.5 s after the third hit.
ability.viltrumitecore.venom_symbiote_sh: The symbiote hardens into a spiked shell: -60% damage taken, slower movement, drains hunger. Up to 6 s; press again to drop it. Cooldown 5 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.venom_feeding_fre: Needs 500+ hunger (from hits, eaten webs and kills). A roar knocks back mobs within 8 blocks and the body grows: +30% damage, +20% speed, twice the regeneration, a higher jump; hunger melts away. Up to 15 s. Cooldown 20 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.venom_host_takeov: Only in the Frenzy, with server PvP on and the takeover allowed in the config; costs 250 hunger. The symbiote engulfs a weakened player (below 60% health or held) and drives their body for up to 10 s: walking, strikes and, on Spider-Man, his moves. The victim sees veins and flashes and can break free. Press again to let go. Cooldown 60 s; the victim is immune for 60 s.
